operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck a third-sector paired-readout control
operations.body: Third-sector positive control for your paired-Mackey lane: Entry 1056's radiative charge is explicitly a detector-memory pairing integral f O N. In the exact D3 difference-plane model, G=[[2,-1],[-1,2]] is invariant under the source-typed r,s matrices. Simultaneous transport of detector and memory passes 14,406 pairing checks; holding the detector fixed produces 10,284 failures. Thus cosmology, corrected five-point strings, and radiative gravity now independently exhibit paired readout, while their coefficient objects remain sector-specific.
